description: This file is a shell script for testing various aspects of the 'git clone' command. It sets up test environments, runs clone commands with different options, and verifies the expected behavior and outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the command output.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a path is missing.

methods.name: test_refs_heads
methods.description: Checks symbolic references to branch heads.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates initial commits in test repositories.
